spans.text: 0006 hours, in the Lincoln Tunnel.
In another corner, after Gr G11 has frozen to death.
...Ow hot!
45! Don't push the coals at me!
Well, this is funny. To think Dolls have fallen to the point where they can't take action without external warmth.
If the engineers at the factory knew this, would they cry?
...That's enough, my head aches.
I would never have imagined that Gr G11 would die because of such a stupid reason.
Haha, well, I think this sensation is quite interesting.
Are we more human now?
We're not just imitating them, but actually warming ourselves to stay alive!
I used to work with humans, and they kept saying that Dolls didn't need to stay warm, so they wouldn't even give me a blanket!
They were right.
What would you even do with a blanket? It's not like Dolls need to sleep.
I know, which is why I said this was a novel experience~
But if we're really going into this, why do you still eat anyway?
I was a military Doll, and when I was in service I had to pay attention to how I interacted with human soldiers.
It would be counterproductive if I triggered the uncanny valley effect in humans under high stress and caused them to attack me.
Also, food can substitute for power to a certain extent. The conversion efficiency isn't too high, but it works for emergencies.
Ehhh... That's a rational but boring answer.
Civilian Dolls were made just to live with humans, with all other functions being of secondary importance.
But I guess they're fundamentally all the same?
That's a very dangerous thought to have, 9.
Don't think about these things, they'll make your neural cloud go weird.
Do you want to end up like those S.F. lunatics?
Eek... Don't scare me like that, 45!
How could it be so bad, I simply thought it felt very new.
You see, I never even considered what it's like to feel cold or hungry!
But now, these sensations are actually having an effect on us.
It's really fun!
This game's simulated environment is a far cry from real life.
The way it forces you to keep these elements in mind is also to enforce limitations which encourage taking tactical courses of action.
Granted, it's an old and busted antique, but a surprising amount of thought went into its design.
I guess I could spare some time to indulge in it.
So what do you plan to do now?
I've never played a game like this before.
It's obviously different from combat simulations too.
Plus, all these data don't take our actual situation into account. What a pain.
What do I want to do, you ask? My plan is to survive to the end and win the prize. Did you even have to ask?
Spare a thought for your team leader here, who has to support an entire family by herself.
As for the game's difficulty and its modes...
Well, it's a game made for humans, so comparing it to sim training would be too harsh.
Still, there are benefits to this. Our chances of winning are very high in games with programmed limits like this.
I'd advise you not to take it too lightly... There's no telling what might happen in an unknown realm.
Also, who knows how many people like you there might be in store.
You don't need to worry about that.
I want to emphasize this again - our course is decided now that Gr G11 is dead.
There are a total of 24 players in this game, so only an idiot would give herself 23 opponents.
All we need to do is deal with the last one, got it?
Understood. Isn't that pretty much what I said, though?
I've always preferred guerrilla tactics to direct confrontations.
Since Gr G11 can't log in again, that's all we can do.
This has always been our forte, after all.
There's no honor in ambushing enemies, but it's super effective!
All your decency must have rotted away for you to take such shameless pride in this sort of thing.
Also, 45's tactic may be underhanded, but it is more than just ambushing and sabotaging our rivals.
The key is to sit back and reap the rewards.
Ahahaha... I didn't expect you to understand her so well, 416.
...Shhhh.
As the pair banter with each other, UMP45 suddenly freezes and gestures for the others to keep quiet as well.
What's wrong, 45?
Quiet... I hear something.
6 o'clock.
Roughly 40 meters away.
9, kill the fire.
Okay!
The trio reacts swiftly, and after putting out the campfire with snow and ashes, they vanish behind cover in an instant.
As the air grows silent, the sounds from the distance steadily become clearer.
...Hic.
This place is a freaking joke... All these cars and you can't drive a single one of them?
How the hell is this realistic?!
And where the hell did those two jerks go? How dare they abandon me!
Is she drunk?
Well, I have to hand it to these Griffin Dolls, they always make their entrance in the most surprising ways.
She's been separated from her people for some reason, that much I can tell, but what is she looking for?
After taking a good look at SKS' face, 45's expression grows strange. She chambers a round quietly.
Meanwhile, 416, who's yet to notice 45's bizarre behavior, continues observing the enemy and voicing her observations.
Beats me. Sounds like she's looking for a vehicle, perhaps?
That said, I've tried them all, the vehicles in this game are just props with no actual functionality.
...Bicycles. If it's cycling, does it even count as drunk driving?!
Bicycles...don't count.
...Don't you think she looks very familiar?
Familiar? I do believe I know her, but we've barely ever interacted, have we?
I don't think we need to disturb her. Just leave her be, it's too early to launch an attack right now.
If I remember correctly, she's part of AK-47's gang, it's not worth it to—
Bang!
UMP45 fires an accurate shot square into SKS' forehead as the latter stumbles around.
A ray of brilliant white light flares up, and the staggering Doll keels over backwards and vanishes into the snow under 416's dumbfounded gaze.
The snowflakes drift and the cold wind blows.
X aaaa killed Green Mark Vodka.
...What the HELL are you doing?!
Weren't you going on and on about how we were supposed to stay hidden and all that?!
Ah... Sorry, I did that on reflex. Force of habit, I suppose.
Habit my ass!
Also, what's this "aaaa" username?
Rich of you to say anything about Gr G11 when you're no better than her!
I think what she said makes quite a lot of sense.
Being killed by someone with a name like this will definitely cause a lot of psychological trauma.
Also, nobody will ever guess that it was me.
Your allies are the first to suffer psychological trauma!
I don't want to be on a team with people called "Pink Nyan Nyan Punch" or "aaaa"!
Oh, by the way, my username is "Reina".
This is hopeless! This blasted team is a freaking joke!
Now, now, why are you making such a scene?
Are you trying to draw all the enemies to us?
All the melodrama aside, what's YOUR username?
...That's none of your business!
It's okay if you don't tell me. We'll find out sooner or later.
Still, I just had the strangest feeling. For some reason, the moment I saw her face, I felt like I was back at Griffin's shooting range.
Then all of a sudden, my trigger finger started itching like mad.
See, it was a pretty good shot, right?
...Cut the crap!
It's not like she was a practice drone or anything!
Well, what's done is done, so there's no point whining about it.
More importantly, her corpse is glowing, so shouldn't we go take a look?
What's so special about that? It's not like the corpse is talking or anything.
Let's see...
Half a bottle of water?
I see... So it's an indicator for dropped items, then?
I think I saw something like it in the games Gr G11 played. The darker the color, the higher the item level.
So what level does white represent?
That's the lowest tier.
...Doesn't that mean it's totally useless?
What has she been doing the whole time she was in the game?
Well, there's nothing else of use here...
Forget it, we'd better leave ASAP. It would be bad if someone were drawn by the sound of the gunshot.
Are we really not going to take the water?
She probably drank it because she thought it was vodka.
Nah. It wouldn't be good even if it WAS vodka.
It's not beer.
...Let's just take it, it might keep us warm or reduce our hunger.
I don't want another teammate to freeze to death.
Also, let me get this out of the way first - you'd better not pull this stupid stunt again!
Ja, ja, ja... I know, let's just go already.
After a brief discussion, the three of them vanish into the snow like ghosts.
